title: Cereal-box phone stand with a locking tab
summary: A fictional cardboard phone stand. An orange tab on the back panel slides down through two guide loops into a slot in the base, which locks the panel angle. Once locked, a phone rests against the panel and stays in place when the screen is tapped.

claims.text: The object being demonstrated is a phone stand.
The stand is made from a cereal box (cardboard).
The small orange tab is the part that moves during locking.
Locking is done by pushing the orange tab down into a slot in the base.
After locking, the tab sits inside the slot in the base.
After locking, the phone stays in place when the screen is tapped.
